attestations.summary: Blast radius tier medium (Kernel batch authority, Host tool surfaces, v2 config key set, derived bundles); every one of the 263 changed paths was covered — 149 modified/added paths by their full diffs (mirrored immune-brain-antigravity and dist copies share identical before/after blob OIDs with the copies read, e.g. 9a68f3edb12..380cb416420 for all eight BASELINE.md paths), 112 deletions by whole-file deletion proof (raw diff status D with zero new OID and 100644 mode, zero of 112 present in git ls-tree -r at the review commit, removal authorized by A1 and Spec D4/scope_hint tests/** and by goal for the batch acceptance doc and verify-batch-completion.ts, no floor path without an acceptance naming it, and a retired-identifier grep leaving only historical .imm/audit, CHANGELOG, plans/ADRs and the tests that assert absence), and both compiled *.mjs bundles by declared derived-bundle proof (claude-mcp-bundle check = A6, antigravity-plugin-artifact check = A7, grep for start_unattended_batch|retire_stale_batch|batch_authority|unattended/|lane_sessions|drive-batch|lane-steward returns zero matches in either bundle); zero dangling imports of the retired modules remain in any .ts/.mjs, and A2's config_invalid/migrate behaviour is pinned by strengthened tests (tests/layered-config.test.ts:80-100). One advisory note: README.zh-CN.md and IMMUNE.md still document the retired batch entry, and the release live gate now requires J1 only on claude.

advisory_findings.summary: README.zh-CN.md (lines 154/603/609/613/707/747) and IMMUNE.md:44 still present the retired unattended batch as the current entry, so the active-doc sync A4 asserts reached README.md but not its maintained Chinese mirror or the system-constitution file; tests/pi-only-current-contracts.test.ts:128-141 still requires README.zh-CN.md to contain the Lane-batch tokens imm/worktrees/<slug>/<task_id> and refs/heads/imm/<slug>.

evidence.trigger: A user or agent reads README.zh-CN.md:603 ("通过 Host 的 start_unattended_batch 执行") or IMMUNE.md:44 (start_unattended_batch as the sole unattended entry, pointing at dist/imm-run-batch.md#parallel-batch-opt-in) and calls that tool -> TOOLS in runtime/host-core/mcp_runtime.ts:139-150 no longer registers start_unattended_batch or retire_stale_batch, so the documented entry fails as an unknown tool and the documented max_parallel/agents config gate no longer exists; the stale tokens are also pinned by a surviving test, so a later doc cleanup breaks a passing suite.

findings.summary: The black-box e2e release gate still asserts and calls the retired start_unattended_batch/retire_stale_batch tools, so `bun run e2e` fails after this retirement.

evidence.trigger: Run the repository's maintained e2e gate after this revision: `bun run e2e install` compares the live MCP/Pi tool listing against tests/e2e/install.e2e.ts MCP_TOOLS/PI_TOOLS, which still require start_unattended_batch and retire_stale_batch, so it fails with `listing_incomplete: MCP tool start_unattended_batch, ...`; `bun run e2e review` calls parent.call("start_unattended_batch", {task_id}) and expects state "started" plus started.report.children[0].lane.path from a server that no longer registers the tool; `bun run e2e skew` reads run.tools.start_unattended_batch and run.tools.status.batch, both removed from the runtime surface by this diff. Before the revision these assertions matched the served surface; the same diff's unit contract (tests/packaged-contract-tool-surface.test.ts) now asserts the opposite of tests/e2e/install.e2e.ts, so the gate cannot pass.

findings.summary: Active reference docs still link to the deleted dist/drive-batch.md and name the retired lane-steward role and batch runtime as live consumers, so the doc/bundle sync is incomplete.

evidence.trigger: Read plugins/immune-brain/README.md or docs/reference/supervised-session-port.md (and its dist mirrors) in this revision: README.md line 47 documents the unattended serial/lane batch and links twice to `dist/drive-batch.md#unattended-batch-opt-in` / `#parallel-batch-opt-in`, a file this revision deletes; docs/reference/supervised-session-port.md line 3 names `dist/drive-batch.md`, `the batch runtime` and the `lane-steward` as the contract's consumers, line 50 attributes `manageWorktree` provisioning to `lane-steward`, and line 149 states the `lane-steward` imports nothing from runtime/session — all three actors/paths are retired by this diff, so the documented consumers no longer exist and the link target is absent. These surviving references also block the whole-file deletion proof for dist/drive-batch.md and dist/role-prompts/lane-steward.md, which require no live reference to remain.
